title: M2 · The shared “are you sure?” box
intro: One box for every section's “are you sure?” asks — 39 of them today, drawn four different ways. The words, colors and button order were decided in the design review (rulebook v1.008, D1a–D1d, D10a); this is the shared box drawing them. Amber outline = what the shared box decides. Three details to OK: (a) while it works, “Keep …” grays too — a new gray look for plain buttons (2); (b) on a narrow phone the buttons stack, decided from their usual words so they never jump while it works (320 pictures); (c) never the pinned button row — today a box on a screen under 700 px tall picks it up by accident. The tablet looks like the PC (shown once). Every state at all four sizes: M2-confirm-box.png.

sections.head: Loses something for good — red action, first focus on “Keep …”
While it works — detail (a): “Keep student” grays too
If it fails — the note under the buttons
Loses something, but not for good — blue action
Loses nothing — blue action with the first focus
Black Belt's “Discard changes?” — the same rule

footer: What changes for each section when it switches (later, in its own prompt): every box shows it's working and waits for Esc and Back (today most show nothing, and nine close while they work) · “Cancel” becomes “Keep …” / “Stay …” · red only when something is lost for good · every box gets a first focus · no box takes the pinned button row.
